test_title: PYST 15 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.

A. She spoke B. so fastly that C. I could barely understand D. what she was saying.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary error in the sentence lies in the use of the word "**fastly**."
 
• "Fastly" is not a valid word in standard English. The word "**fast**" is an irregular adverb, meaning it functions as both an adjective and an adverb without needing the "-ly" suffix.
 
• Therefore, the correct adverbial form to describe how she spoke is simply "**fast**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in the segment **so fastly that**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She spoke **so fast that** I could barely understand what she was saying."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **She spoke** – This segment is grammatically correct. It establishes a clear subject and a past tense verb.
 
• **I could barely understand** – This segment is correct. "Barely" is used correctly as an adverb modifying the verb phrase "could understand."
 
• **what she was saying.** – This segment is correct. It functions perfectly as a noun clause acting as the direct object of "understand."
